# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- For this WinForms project, create new interfaces as separate Forms using Visual Studio Designer-generated code, preserving editable control layout and matching requested visual styling.
- When creating WinForms Designer files, keep `InitializeComponent` declarative and design-time compatible; do not use runtime loops, local variables, or helper logic inside the generated Designer method.
- When integrating controls into the WinForms Model form, re-check the latest Designer file because the user may have just added controls such as tabPage2 in Visual Studio.
